text: CI protects the code. Nothing yet watches the pipeline while it's actually running -- this lesson adds that.
Three CloudWatch alarms, one shared SNS topic: Lambda errors on the ingest function, Kinesis iterator age for consumer lag, and Step Functions execution failures.
Iterator age is the standard signal for a struggling consumer -- and a rising one means Lambda may be retrying, the exact condition behind a real bug this series finds later.
Every alarm routes to one SNS topic with an on-call email subscription. Each one gets verified by actually triggering it, not just trusting the Terraform applied cleanly.
The pipeline now pages someone the same day something breaks. Next: billing flags a number that looks wrong.
